posts.author: MaliceAliceJests
posts.body:
Hi!! I'm extremely new here as I just got my account and wanted to ask about an issue I've been having. I'm working on an entirely pixel based game in RPG Maker MV and have been creating custom tilesets for all the pixel art. All the tiles in the tile sheets I made are 48x48 so it matches fine when I place them, and when I looked up to see if my issue was caused by the tile sheets being a certain dimension, I didn't find much about that either, and even edited my tiles on top of ones in a tileset that comes with the engine that shouldn't have the issue if it was caused by dimensions and tested it out and still had the same problem. I researched for a few hours about turning off anti-aliasing and changing the game to be more pixelated or mess with the resolution too, and still nothing.
(For reference here is what I found and also tested out before I came here)
How to remove blur?
Yesterday there was a topic that included this, but it never really got answered. So, here's a thread dedicated to it... how to remove the blur when resizing the game's window? I'd like to keep the pixel look, even in full screen.
forums.rpgmakerweb.com
blurry full screen
hi, the game im making is going to be very basic pixel art with no anti aliasing, and it looks fine when its windowed but when i full screen it gets blurry. i know in the program game maker you can turn off the auto anti aliasing that happens when you full screen so that the pixel art still...
forums.rpgmakerweb.com
So the issue is that the pixels are weirdly stretching and morphing in different ways in game, both fullscreen and windowed. I've dug into the index folder, rpg_windows, rpg_core, and tons of plugins now and can't find a solution. For the game to look good with the pixel art it needs to look exactly like how I put the pixels down on the tileset so I'm just looking for any kind of solution, even if it's really difficult to pull off, so I can continue working on this project. I do want to mention that I am using a plugin that zooms the game in and out with a plugin command so I use that on every room of the game to bring you closer to the screen, as smaller rooms look tiny when not zoomed in. Because of this, I noticed that when you zoom super far in this problem pretty much disappears as you're super close to the pixels now, but I can't have what's basically a bubble POV for the player haha, so I need a better fix for this where the player can still be at medium range or far out and the pixels work fine.
I'll put some photos down here for comparison so you can see what I mean. The top ones are the pixels in the tilesets and the bottom is them in game. The grass one looks a little different because I have several variants of it, but they all warp the same anyway.
Thank you so much for your help!!
